use default
use Raster.IMAGE

use Point = (x: double, y: double)

let control: Point[] = [
    (171.0D, 171.0D), (185.0D, 111.0D), (202.0D, 109.0D), (202.0D, 189.0D),
    (328.0D, 160.0D), (208.0D, 254.0D), (241.0D, 330.0D), (164.0D, 252.0D),
    (69.0D, 278.0D), (139.0D, 208.0D), (72.0D, 148.0D), (168.0D, 172.0D)
]

let degree = 3
let spans = control.count - degree

knot(i: int) -> double =>
    cast double(System.Math.clamp(i - degree, 0, spans))

lerp(a: Point, b: Point, t: double) -> Point =>
    (x = a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t, y = a.y + (b.y - a.y) * t)

de_boor(t: double) -> Point is
    let span = System.Math.min(cast int(t), spans - 1) + degree
    let d = LIST[Point]((0::degree) |> map(j => control[j + span - degree]))

    for r in 1::degree do
        for step in 0::degree - r do
            let j = degree - step
            let i = j + span - degree
            let left = knot(i)
            let right = knot(i + degree + 1 - r)
            let alpha = (t - left) / (right - left)

            d[j] = lerp(d[j - 1], d[j], alpha)
        od
    od

    d[degree]
si

let samples = 400

let curve =
    (0::samples)
        |> map(s => de_boor(cast double(spans * s) / cast double(samples)))
        |> collect_list()

let image = IMAGE(400, 400)

image.clear(252ub, 250ub, 245ub)

image.colour(190ub, 190ub, 200ub)
image.stroke(1.0D)
image.line(control)

image.colour(200ub, 60ub, 50ub)

for p in control do
    image.dot(p.x, p.y, 3.0D)
od

image.colour(30ub, 70ub, 150ub)
image.stroke(2.5D)
image.line(curve)

let first = curve[0]
let last = curve[curve.count - 1]

write_line("clamped cubic B-spline over {control.count} control points")
write_line("starts at ({first.x:F1}, {first.y:F1})")
write_line("ends at ({last.x:F1}, {last.y:F1})")

image.write("b-spline.png")

image.show("b-spline.png")
